/*
Author : 1121329
create date :20250626
memo : AUM細項指標

/*  
--9.8.7.5.實際: 存款 AUM總量
--歷史存款資料執行較久，將歷史資料一次性CREATE 後(執行時間為2025/5)，後續再與現況UNION，可減少重新執行時間，
drop table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP01;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP01
as  
    SELECT  cust_id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'台幣' AS TYP_DTL,
            case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
             TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, sum(BAL_AMT) as 存款AUM 
    FROM DSDEP.DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
    WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400')   
        AND LST_MTN_DT>='20231201'
    group by cust_id,LST_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACT_CD,
          case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end;

drop table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP02;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP02
as              
    SELECT  cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'台幣' AS TYP_DTL, 
            case 
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2317','2327') then '外幣存款'
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
            TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACC_CD, sum(AVAIL_BAL) as 存款AUM --  '台幣'  AS TYP,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, AVAIL_BAL, GROSS_INCM 
    FROM DSDEP.DEP_FN_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
    WHERE TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400')   AND LST_MTN_DT>='20231201'
    group by cust_id,lst_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACC_CD,
          case 
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2317','2327') then '外幣存款'
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end ;
             
drop table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP03;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP03
as     
    SELECT cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'外幣' AS TYP_DTL,
            case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
             TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, sum(BAL_AMT) as 存款AUM --, GROSS_INCM 
    FROM DSDEP.EMP_DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
    WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND LST_MTN_DT>='20231201'
    group by cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACT_CD
;
*/
--current
drop table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP04;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP04
as  
    SELECT  cust_id,DATA_DT,'存款' as TYP,'台幣' AS TYP_DTL,
             case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
            TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, sum(BAL_AMT) as AMT 
    FROM DSDEP.DEP_NT_ACCT@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
    group by cust_id,DATA_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACT_CD,
             case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end   
;
drop table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP05;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP05
as 
    SELECT  cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'台幣' AS TYP_DTL,
            case 
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2317','2327') then '外幣存款'
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
            TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACC_CD, sum(AVAIL_BAL) as 存款AUM--  '台幣'  AS TYP,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, AVAIL_BAL, GROSS_INCM 
    FROM DSDEP.DEP_FN_ACCT@anadbp01_dwdbp01
    group by cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACC_CD,
          case 
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2317','2327') then '外幣存款'
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end;
--更新區間　2025/6後
drop table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP06;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP06
as  
    SELECT  cust_id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'台幣' AS TYP_DTL,
            case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
             TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, sum(BAL_AMT) as 存款AUM 
    FROM DSDEP.DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
    WHERE   YYYYMM>='202506'
    group by cust_id,LST_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACT_CD,
          case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end;

drop table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP07;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP07
as              
    SELECT  cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'台幣' AS TYP_DTL, 
            case 
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2317','2327') then '外幣存款'
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
            TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACC_CD, sum(AVAIL_BAL) as 存款AUM --  '台幣'  AS TYP,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, AVAIL_BAL, GROSS_INCM 
    FROM DSDEP.DEP_FN_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
    WHERE  YYYYMM>='202506'
    group by cust_id,lst_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACC_CD,
          case 
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2317','2327') then '外幣存款'
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end ;
             
drop table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP08;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP08
as     
    SELECT cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'外幣' AS TYP_DTL,
            case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
             TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, sum(BAL_AMT) as 存款AUM --, GROSS_INCM 
    FROM DSDEP.EMP_DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
    WHERE   YYYYMM>='202506'
    group by cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACT_CD
;


drop table AUM_005_007_008_009;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009
as
select  a.*,
        case when detail in ('台幣存款','外幣存款') then '台外幣存款' 
        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP01 a 
union 
select  a.*,
        case when detail in ('台幣存款','外幣存款') then '台外幣存款' 
        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP02 a 
union 
select  a.*,
        case when detail in ('台幣存款','外幣存款') then '台外幣存款' 
        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP03 a 
union 
select  a.*,
        case when detail in ('台幣存款','外幣存款') then '台外幣存款' 
        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP04 a 
union 
select  a.*,
        case when detail in ('台幣存款','外幣存款') then '台外幣存款' 
        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP05 a 
union
select  a.*,
        case when detail in ('台幣存款','外幣存款') then '台外幣存款' 
        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP06 a 
union 
select  a.*,
        case when detail in ('台幣存款','外幣存款') then '台外幣存款' 
        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP07 a 
union 
select  a.*,
        case when detail in ('台幣存款','外幣存款') then '台外幣存款' 
        else detail end as TYP_SUB_DTL
from AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP08 a 
;

---12.銀行_保險_AUM總量
--AUM資料為月批(至上個月)，當月資料須抓取最後一個月的資料值
drop table AUM_012_TMP01;
create table AUM_012_TMP01
as  
select orgcust_key as cust_id ,date_key as YYYYMMDD ,sum(AMT_INVEST) AMT
from DSKPI.AFAUM_AFCUST_MON_ASSET_REPORT@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group by orgcust_key,date_key;

drop table AUM_012_TMP02;
create table AUM_012_TMP02
as  
select orgcust_key as cust_id ,to_char(sysdate-1,'yyyymmdd') as YYYYMMDD ,sum(AMT_INVEST) AMT
from DSKPI.AFAUM_AFCUST_MON_ASSET_REPORT@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where date_key =
       (select  max(date_key) date_key from DSKPI.AFAUM_AFCUST_MON_ASSET_REPORT@anadbp01_dwdbp01 ) 
group by orgcust_key,to_char(sysdate,'yyyymmdd');

drop table AUM_012;
create table AUM_012
as
select * from AUM_012_TMP01
union 
select * from AUM_012_TMP02;


/*以下皆為投資AUM*/
-- 13-18.投資AUM各細項產品
drop table AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018;
create table AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
as 
select 
    idno cust_id,to_char(exedate,'yyyymmdd') yyyymmdd,PCCCODE,idno,
    case 
       when trustprd in ('其他-國外有價證券','其他-國外股票','股票') then '海外股票'
       when trustprd ='集合' then '集合管理帳戶'
       when trustprd ='海外債券' then '海外債券(信託)'
       when trustprd ='結構型商品' then '境外結構型商品'
    else trustprd end as trustprd,
    sum(CurrentTWDValue) CurrentTWDValue    
from DSFND.PB_FUND_MONTH@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group by  idno,to_char(exedate,'yyyymmdd') ,PCCCODE,idno,case 
       when trustprd in ('其他-國外有價證券','其他-國外股票','股票') then '海外股票'
       when trustprd ='集合' then '集合管理帳戶'
       when trustprd ='海外債券' then '海外債券(信託)'
       when trustprd ='結構型商品' then '境外結構型商品'
    else trustprd end;
    
--19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
drop table AUM_019_TMP_01;
create table AUM_019_TMP_01
as 
select CIF_ID AS CUST_ID,Data_dt as YYYYMMDD,sum(STO_AMT * MKT_PRI /100 * EXC_RATE) AMT
from DSWTR.BOND_POS_DAY@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where pcc_code like '2E%'
group by CIF_ID,Data_dt;

drop table AUM_019;
create table AUM_019
as 
select a.*
from AUM_019_TMP_01 a 
inner join 
(
  select substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm ,max(yyyymmdd) yyyymmdd 
  from AUM_019_TMP_01
  group by substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)
 ) b on a.yyyymmdd=b.yyyymmdd;


--20.【銀行】員工福利信託_市值
drop table AUM_020_TMP01;
create table AUM_020_TMP01
as
select to_char(baldate,'yyyymmdd') yyyymmdd,idno as cust_id ,sum(PresentAmt) AMT
from DSEBS.EBTS_ACT_CntAUMBal_PB@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group by to_char(baldate,'yyyymmdd'),idno;

drop table AUM_020;
create table AUM_020
as
select a.yyyymmdd,a.cust_id,a.AMT
from AUM_020_TMP01 a
inner join 
  (
  select   substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,max(yyyymmdd) yyyymmdd
  from AUM_020_TMP01
  group by substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)
  ) b
on a.yyyymmdd=b.yyyymmdd;

--21.【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
drop table AUM_021_TMP01;
create table AUM_021_TMP01
as
select substr(postdate,1,8) yyyymmdd,id as cust_Id ,sum( MarketValueTWD)  AMT
from  DSTAM.TRUCONTRACT_PB@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group by substr(postdate,1,8),id;

drop table AUM_021;
create table AUM_021
as
select a.yyyymmdd,a.cust_id,a.AMT
from AUM_021_TMP01 a
inner join 
  (
  select   substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,max(yyyymmdd) yyyymmdd
  from AUM_021_TMP01
  group by substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)
  ) b
on a.yyyymmdd=b.yyyymmdd;
--22.銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
drop table AUM_022_TMP01;
create table AUM_022_TMP01
as
select cust_Id,"DATE" as YYYYMMDD,sum(AUM) as AMT
from DSPMS.PB_PMS_AUM@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group by cust_id,"DATE";

drop table AUM_022;
create table AUM_022
as
select a.yyyymmdd,a.cust_id,a.AMT
from AUM_022_TMP01 a
inner join 
  (
  select   substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,max(yyyymmdd) yyyymmdd
  from AUM_022_TMP01
  group by substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)
  ) b
on a.yyyymmdd=b.yyyymmdd;

--23.24.【證券】複委託-債券_市值
--23.證券_複委託債券_AUM總量 1. BOND 開頭非「TSSN」 2.取值 NETQTY/100 *CPRICE * 折台清算匯率
--24.證券_複委託結構型商品_AUM總量 1. BOND 開頭為「TSSN」 2.取值 NETQTY/100 *CPRICE * 折台清算匯率 
--證券資料要抓取上個月月底匯率
drop table AUM_023_024_TMP0;
create table AUM_023_024_TMP0
as 
select idno as cust_id,prcs_dt as yyyymmdd,nm,sum(NETQTY/100 *CPRICE * exch_rt) AMT
from 
      (select a.*,
              case when  bond like 'TSSN%' then '複委託結構型商品'
              else '複委託債券' end as NM
      from  DSPBM.PB_BONDPOS_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a ) a
left join 
     ( select A.*
     from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
     inner join 
     ( 
         select substr(prcs_dt,1,6) yyyyymm,max(prcs_dt) prcs_dt 
         from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
         group by substr(prcs_dt,1,6)
     ) b on a.prcs_dt=b.prcs_dt
     )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and a.yyyymm=substr(b.prcs_dt,1,6)
group by idno,prcs_dt,nm
;
drop table AUM_023_024_TMP1;
create table AUM_023_024_TMP1
as 
select  idno as cust_id,clrdate as yyyymmdd,nm,sum(NETQTY/100 *CPRICE * exch_rt) AMT
from 
(
 select a.*,b.*,
         case when  bond like 'TSSN%' then '複委託結構型商品'
       else '複委託債券' end as NM
from  DSPBM.PB_BONDPOS_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a 
left join  dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01  b 
on a.clrdate=b.prcs_dt and  a.currency=b.curr_cd
) a 
group by idno,clrdate,nm;

drop table AUM_023_024;
create table AUM_023_024
as 
select * from AUM_023_024_TMP0
union 
select * from AUM_023_024_TMP1;

--current現況 select * from DSPBM.PB_BONDPOS_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01
  --25.證券_基金_AUM總量
drop table AUM_025;
create table AUM_025
  as 
  select wkb02 as cust_id,yyyymmdd ,sum(WKB28 * WKB23 * WKB31) as amt
  from DSPBM.PB_FUNDPOSIT_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01
  group by wkb02,yyyymmdd
  union 
  select wkb02 as cust_id,yyyymmdd ,sum(WKB28* WKB23 * WKB31) as amt
  from DSPBM.PB_FUNDPOSIT_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01
  group by wkb02,yyyymmdd
  ;
    --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
drop table AUM_026_TMP0;
create table AUM_026_TMP0
as 
select   idno as cust_id,b.prcs_dt yyyymmdd,sum(NETQTY * CPRICE* exch_rt) as amt 
from  (select *
      from  DSPBM.PB_STOCKPOS_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a ) a
left join 
     ( select A.*
     from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
     inner join 
     ( 
         select substr(prcs_dt,1,6) yyyyymm,max(prcs_dt) prcs_dt 
         from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
         group by substr(prcs_dt,1,6)
     ) b on a.prcs_dt=b.prcs_dt
     )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and a.yyyymm=substr(b.prcs_dt,1,6)
group by idno,b.prcs_dt
;    

drop table AUM_026_TMP1;
create table AUM_026_TMP1
as 
select  idno as cust_id,yyyymmdd,sum(NETQTY * CPRICE* exch_rt) as amt 
  from 
 (
  select idno, CLRDATE  YYYYMMDD,NETQTY ,CPRICE,currency --
  from DSPBM.PB_STOCKPOS_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01
  ) a
  left join 
  (
  select * from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 --where prcs_dt='20240401'
  )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and yyyymmdd=prcs_dt
  group by idno,yyyymmdd;
 
drop table AUM_026;
create table AUM_026
as 
select * from AUM_026_TMP0
union 
select * from AUM_026_TMP1;

--27.證券_台股_AUM總量
drop table AUM_027;
create table AUM_027
as 
select cust_id,yyyymmdd,sum(amt) amt
from 
(
select YTRMRB025 as cust_id,yyyymmdd,YTRMRB110 * YTRMRB150  as amt
from dspbm.pb_ytrmrbp_sec_m@anadbp01_dwdbp01
union 
select YTRMRB025 as cust_id,yyyymmdd,YTRMRB110 * YTRMRB150  as amt
from dspbm.pb_ytrmrbp_sec@anadbp01_dwdbp01
) a
group by cust_id,yyyymmdd;
--28.股票設質
drop table AUM_028;
create table AUM_028
as 
select to_char(to_date(applydate,'yyyy/mm/dd'),'YYYYMMDD') YYYYMMDD ,lendinguserid as cust_id,sum(Qty * Product_Price) amt
from DSCSD.PBCMS_REPORTA03@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group by to_char(to_date(applydate,'yyyy/mm/dd'),'YYYYMMDD') ,lendinguserid;

EXIT;

drop table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP01;
create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP01
as  
    SELECT  cust_id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'台幣' AS TYP_DTL,
            case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
             TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, sum(BAL_AMT) as 存款AUM

properties.rawSql:
/*
Author : 1121329
create date :20250626
memo : AUM彙整指標
*/

drop table AUM;
create table AUM
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,

properties.rawSql:
/*
Author : 1121329
create date :20250610
memo : 
     收入各指標細項開發
*/

--28.銀行保險手收(日更新)  --COMM_AMT 僅有2025/5月Current檔案
--from dxdmb.aum_acct_ft@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
--select * from DSINS.INSU_RPT_Q01@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
drop table INCOME_028;
create table INCOME_028
as 
select dept_easy_nm,dept_easy_nm2,applicant_id as cust_id,apply_dt as yyyymmdd,sum(COMM_AMT) AMT--dept_easy_nm,dept_easy_nm2,
from DSINS.INSU_RPT_Q01@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group by dept_easy_nm,dept_easy_nm2,applicant_id,apply_dt;
--29.【銀行】保險手收 總量(月更新) --取值PS  
--20251124 調整抓取LST_MTN_DT的下一個月為收入
drop table INCOME_029;
create table INCOME_029
as 
select  cust_id ,
        to_char(add_months(to_date(lst_mtn_dt,'yyyymmdd'),1),'yyyymmdd')as  yyyymmdd,
        sum(ps) amt --,* --lst_mtn_dt,category,sum(ps) --AO_ID,CUST_ID,PS
from DSKPI.KPI_DET_IU_002_NEW@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where ps is not null
group by cust_id ,lst_mtn_dt; 

--where insure_START_DATE = '01140221'
--30.【銀行】保險手收 總量(月更新)   --取值PS
--20251124 調整抓取LST_MTN_DT的下一個月為收入
drop table INCOME_030;
create table INCOME_030
as 
select cust_id ,to_char(add_months(to_date(lst_mtn_dt,'yyyymmdd'),1),'yyyymmdd') as yyyymmdd,sum(ps) amt  -- source_name,lst_mtn_dt,sum(ps) ps,count(*) 人數 --distinct lst_mtn_dt 
from DSKPI.KPI_DET_OFI_001@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where open_account='Y'
group by cust_id ,lst_mtn_dt;
--31.【銀行】海外債券手收 總量

drop table INCOME_031;
create table INCOME_031
as 
select baopcccode as PCCODE,
       idno as cust_id ,
       to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymmdd') as yyyymmdd, 
       sum(BRHREBATEAMT+(WKR028/100)) amt--baopcccode,sum(BRHREBATEAMT+(WKR028/100)) --feedate,sum(BRHREBATEAMT+(WKR028/100))
from DSFND.PB_FUND_SPREAD_DAILY@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where FHID='CB' --and substr(feedate,1,6)='011403'--01121227    
and baopcccode like '%2E%'    --私銀處
group by baopcccode,idno,feedate;

--and BRHREBATEAMT+(WKR028/100)=416
--32.【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量  -- INC_AMT_NT
drop table INCOME_032;
create table INCOME_032
as 
select cif_id as cust_id ,txn_dt as yyyymmdd,PCC_CODE pccode,sum(ABS(INC_AMT_NT)) amt
from DSWTR.BOND_TXN@anadbp01_dwdbp01
WHERE pcc_code LIKE '2E%'
group by cif_id,txn_dt,PCC_CODE;
--33.34.35.36【銀行】基金手收 總量
--20251124 調整新增判斷saopcccode like '2E%'
drop table INCOME_033_034_035_036;
create table INCOME_033_034_035_036
as 
select  to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' ) as yyyymmdd --substr(FEEDATE,1,6)  -- FHID,IDNO as cust_id,      
        ,idno as cust_id       
        ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
        end as   FH_TYP 
        ,baopcccode PCCODE
        ,sum(BrhRebateAmt) as AMT
from DSFND.PB_FUND_SPREAD_DAILY@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
where  (baopcccode like '2E%' or saopcccode like '2E%') and feedate>='011212'  --and feedate='011403' 
group by  
      to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' )   --substr(FEEDATE,1,6),
      ,idno
      ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
       end
       ,baopcccode;
        
--37.【銀行】DCI 手收 總量  --DSDEP.DCI_PERFO_RPT CURRENT
drop table INCOME_037;
create table INCOME_037
as 
select 
       trade_date as yyyymmdd,
       customer_id as cust_id,
       RM_PCCODE PCCODE,
       sum(FEE_AMOUNT_TWD) AMT --customer_id as cust_Id
from DSDEP.DCI_PERFO_RPT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group  by  
       trade_date,
       customer_id,
       RM_PCCODE
union 
select 
       trade_date,
       customer_id,
       RM_PCCODE RM_PCCODE,
       sum(FEE_AMOUNT_TWD) AMT --customer_id as cust_Id
from DSDEP.DCI_PERFO_RPT@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group  by  
       trade_date,
       customer_id,
       RM_PCCODE    
  ;
--38.【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
drop table INCOME_038;
create table INCOME_038
as
select to_char(to_date(TRIM(postdate), 'YYYY/MM/DD'),'yyyymmdd') yyyymmdd,
       entitynumber as cust_id,
       CONFCLASSCODE PCCODE,
       sum(TmuProfit) AMT
from DSTAS.FO108_W@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where TRIM(Product)='DCD'
group by to_char(to_date(TRIM(postdate), 'YYYY/MM/DD'),'yyyymmdd'),
      entitynumber,
      CONFCLASSCODE
      ;

--39.【銀行】境內結構型商品手收 總量
--PB SI 交易明細
drop table INCOME_039;
create table INCOME_039
as 
select customer_id cust_id ,
       trade_date yyyymmdd,
       S_PCC_CODE PCCODE,
       sum(FEE_AMOUNT_TWD) AMT
from DSDEP.SI_PERFO_RPT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01   --CURRENT檔案  DSDEP.SI_PERFO_RPT 
group by customer_id,trade_date,S_PCC_CODE
union 
select customer_id cust_id ,
       trade_date yyyymmdd,
       S_PCC_CODE PCCODE,
       sum(FEE_AMOUNT_TWD) AMT
from DSDEP.SI_PERFO_RPT@anadbp01_dwdbp01   --CURRENT檔案  DSDEP.SI_PERFO_RPT 
group by customer_id,trade_date,S_PCC_CODE;

--40.ELI戰報   DSDEP.ELI_PERFO_RPT
drop table INCOME_040;
create table INCOME_040
as 
select trade_date yyyymmdd,
       customer_id cust_id, 
       RM_PCCODE PCCODE,
       sum(FEE_AMOUNT) AMT
from DSDEP.ELI_PERFO_RPT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01  --CURRENT 檔案 DSDEP.ELI_PERFO_RPT
group by trade_date,customer_id,RM_PCCODE
union
select trade_date yyyymmdd,
       customer_id cust_id,
       RM_PCCODE PCCODE, 
       sum(FEE_AMOUNT) AMT
from DSDEP.ELI_PERFO_RPT@anadbp01_dwdbp01  --CURRENT 檔案 DSDEP.ELI_PERFO_RPT
group by trade_date,customer_id,RM_PCCODE
 ;

-- FEE_AMOUNT_TWD-->PB FCI 交易明細
--41.FCI戰報
drop table INCOME_041;
create table INCOME_041
as 
select customer_id cust_id
       ,trade_date yyyymmdd
       ,O_PCC_CODE PCCODE
       ,sum(fee_amount_twd) AMT
from DSDEP.FCI_PERFO_RPT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where status_ch='新增'
group by customer_id,trade_date,O_PCC_CODE
union 
select customer_id cust_id
       ,trade_date yyyymmdd
      ,O_PCC_CODE PCCODE
       ,sum(fee_amount_twd) AMT
from DSDEP.FCI_PERFO_RPT@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where status_ch='新增'
group by customer_id,trade_date,O_PCC_CODE;
  

--42.【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量 PB ELI 交易明細
--DSDEP.ELI_PERFO_RPT
drop table INCOME_042;
create table INCOME_042
as 
select to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymmdd') as yyyymmdd,
       idno as cust_id,
       BAOPCCCODE PCCODE,
       sum(BrhRebateAmt) AMT --BrhRebateAmt
from DSFND.PB_FUND_SPREAD_DAILY@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where FHID='SN' and baopcccode like '2E%'
group by feedate,idno,baopcccode;

--43.【銀行】FX手收 總量
--銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
--20251124 移除 PCC_CODE 為2E條件
drop table INCOME_043_TMP01;
create table INCOME_043_TMP01
as 
select to_char(to_date(PROC_DATE,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymmdd') yyyymmdd,
       cust_id,
       pcc_code PCCODE,
       sum(BAL_AMT_TWD) AMT  -- BAL_AMT_TWD
from DSWBS.PB_SPOT_Daily@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group by to_char(to_date(PROC_DATE,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymmdd')
,cust_id,pcc_code;

drop table INCOME_043_TMP02;
create table INCOME_043_TMP02
as 
select to_char(to_date(PROC_DATE,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymmdd') yyyymmdd,
       cust_id,
       pcc_code PCCODE,
       sum(BAL_AMT_TWD) AMT  -- BAL_AMT_TWD
from DSWBS.PB_SPOT_Daily_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where pcc_code like '2E%'
group by to_char(to_date(PROC_DATE,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymmdd')
,cust_id,pcc_code;

drop table INCOME_043;
create table INCOME_043
as 
select * from INCOME_043_TMP01
union 
select * from INCOME_043_TMP02;
--select * from DSWBS.PB_SPOT_Daily@anadbp01_dwdbp01
--44.【銀行】FX手收 總量--銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
--20251124 調整 不排除2E條件
drop table INCOME_044;
create table INCOME_044
as 
select to_char(to_date(TRIM(usertradedate), 'YYYY/MM/DD'),'yyyymmdd')  yyyymmdd --TmuProfit
       ,entitynumber as cust_id 
       ,sum(TmuProfit) as AMT  
from DSTAS.FO108_W@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where TRIM(Product) not in  ('DCD','Cash Bond')
group by to_char(to_date(TRIM(usertradedate), 'YYYY/MM/DD'),'yyyymmdd') ,entitynumber;

--45.【銀行】開狀手收 總量
drop table INCOME_045;
create table INCOME_045
as 
select 
        proc_date yyyymmdd,
        cust_id,
        PCC_CODE PCCODE,
        sum(FEE_AMT) AMT   
from DSWBS.IMPM007_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where to_char(to_date(FEE_END_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'YYYYMMDD') >= to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD')
group by proc_date,cust_id,PCC_CODE
union 
select 
        proc_date ,
        cust_id,
        PCC_CODE PCCODE,
        sum(FEE_AMT)  AMT    
from DSWBS.IMPM007@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where to_char(to_date(FEE_END_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'YYYYMMDD') >= to_char(sysdate,'YYYYMMDD')
group by proc_date ,
        cust_id,
        PCC_CODE 
        ;
--
--46.【銀行】信託保管費手收 總量
--規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
drop table INCOME_046;
create table INCOME_046
as 
select postdate yyyymmdd,
       id as cust_id, 
       sum(SecuritiesBrwFee+SecuritiesMngFee+SecuritiesCrgFee+PecuniaryMngFee+PecuniaryCrgFee) as AMT
from DSTAM.TRUCONTRACT_PB@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group by postdate,id;

--47.規劃型信託(員工持股信託)  --累計
drop table INCOME_047;
create table INCOME_047
as

properties.rawSql:
/*
Author : 1121329
create date :20250610
memo : 
     彙總收入收入儀表盤
*/

drop table INCOME_TMP01;
Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '放款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_067 --放款利收總量
;     


drop table INCOME_TMP02;
Create table INCOME_TMP02
as 
select a.*,
       b.emp_no,
       b.prft_cntr_cd,
       b.sht_nm,
       case 
          when sht_nm like '%業務一部%' then 'TW一部'
          when sht_nm like '%業務二部%' then 'TW二部'
        end as SHT_EASY_NM,
      substr(
          sht_nm,
          instr(sht_nm,'業')+2,
          instr(sht_nm,'部') -instr(sht_nm,'業') -1
          )  as SHT_SUB_NM, 
       b.pst_nm
--count(*)
from INCOME_TMP01 a   --55772
left join PB_CUST_005 b  --55772
on a.cust_id =b.cust_id and substr(a.yyyymmdd,1,6)=b.yyyymm;

drop table INCOME_REPORT;
Create table INCOME_REPORT
as 
select 
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,4) yyyy,
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,
       yyyymmdd,
       typ,
       prod_type,
       sub_type,
       prft_cntr_cd,
       sht_nm,
       sht_easy_nm,
       '私人銀行'||sht_sub_nm as sht_sub_nm ,
       sum(amt) AMT,
       count(*) CNT
from INCOME_TMP02
where prft_cntr_cd is not null
group by 
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,4) ,
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) ,
       yyyymmdd,
       typ,
       prod_type,
       sub_type,
       prft_cntr_cd,
       sht_nm,
       sht_easy_nm,
       sht_sub_nm;
       
 EXIT;

properties.rawSql:
/*
Author : 1121329
create date :20250626
memo : 
     ROA :  總收入/AUM
     ROBA : 放款客戶總收入/LUM
*/


drop table ROA_TMP_01;
create table ROA_TMP_01
as 
select a.*,b.amt as INCOME,
       c.AUM as AUM ,
       d.ln_amt 
from PB_CUST_TMP06 a  --客戶  28470
left join  ( select cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,sum(amt) amt from INCOME_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) ) b  --收入 28470
on a.yyyymm=b.yyyymm and a.cust_id=b.cust_id
left join (select substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,cust_id,sum(amt) AUM from AUM_TMP02 group by cust_id,substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)) c --AUM  --28470
on a.yyyymm=c.yyyymm and a.cust_id=c.cust_id

having count(*)>1
;

union

from dscif.aodep@anadbp01_dwdbp01;

select *
from AUM_TMP01 
where typ='投資'
;

as 
select a.*,
       b.emp_no,
       b.prft_cntr_cd,
       b.sht_nm,
       case 
          when sht_nm like '%業務一部%' then 'TW一部'

        end as SHT_EASY_NM,

on a.cust_id =b.cust_id and substr(a.yyyymmdd,1,6)=b.yyyymm;
--where sht_nm like '%銀行一部%' or sht_nm like '%銀行二部%';

drop table AUM_REPORT;
Create table AUM_REPORT
as 
select 
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,4) yyyy,
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,
       yyyymmdd,
       typ,
       TYP_SUB_DTL,
       COMP,
       PROD,
       prft_cntr_cd,
       sht_nm,
       sht_easy_nm,
       sht_sub_nm,
       sum(amt) AMT,
       count(*) CNT
from AUM_TMP02 
where sht_easy_nm is not null
group by 
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,4) ,
       substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) ,
       yyyymmdd,
       typ,
       TYP_SUB_DTL,
       COMP,
       PROD,
       prft_cntr_cd,
       sht_nm,
       sht_easy_nm,
       sht_sub_nm;

EXIT;

Create table AUM_TMP02
as 
select a.*,
       b.emp_no,
       b.prft_cntr_cd,
       b.sht_nm,
       case 
          when sht_nm like '%業務一部%' then 'TW一部'
          when sht_nm like '%業務二部%' then 'TW二部'
        end as SHT_EASY_NM,

as  
    SELECT  cust_id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'台幣' AS TYP_DTL,
            case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
             TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, sum(BAL_AMT) as 存款AUM 
    FROM DSDEP.DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
    WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400')   
        AND LST_MTN_DT>='20231201'
    group by cust_id,LST_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACT_CD,
          case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end;

properties.sql:
create table INCOME_066_TMP01
as
     SELECT cust_id,yyyymmdd,sum(AMT) AMT
     FROM (
        SELECT cust_id,yyyymm || '01'  yyyymmdd, sum(GROSS_INCM)  AMT --TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, BAL_AMT, GROSS_INCM 利息 
        FROM DSDEP.DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
        where TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND YYYYMM>='202312' and YYYYMM<='202505'
        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cust_id, yyyymm || '01' yyyymmdd,sum(GROSS_INCM)  AMT --* --TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, AVAIL_BAL, GROSS_INCM 
        FROM DSDEP.DEP_FN_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
        WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND YYYYMM>='202312' and YYYYMM<='202505'
        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        UNION ALL
        SELECT  cust_id, yyyymm || '01' yyyymmdd,sum(GROSS_INCM)  AMT-- TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, BAL_AMT, GROSS_INCM 
        FROM DSDEP.EMP_DEP_NT_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
        WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND YYYYMM>='202312' and YYYYMM<='202505'
        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        ) 
GROUP BY cust_id,yyyymmdd;

create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP02
as              
    SELECT  cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'台幣' AS TYP_DTL, 
            case 
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2317','2327') then '外幣存款'
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
            TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACC_CD, sum(AVAIL_BAL) as 存款AUM --  '台幣'  AS TYP,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, AVAIL_BAL, GROSS_INCM 
    FROM DSDEP.DEP_FN_ACCT_HS@anadbp01_dwdbp01
    WHERE TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400')   AND LST_MTN_DT>='20231201'
    group by cust_id,lst_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACC_CD,
          case 
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2317','2327') then '外幣存款'
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end ;

create table AUM_005_007_008_009_TMP03
as     
    SELECT cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'外幣' AS TYP_DTL,
            case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
             TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, sum(BAL_AMT) as 存款AUM --, GROSS_INCM

    WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND LST_MTN_DT>='20231201'
    group by cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACT_CD
;

        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        UNION ALL
        SELECT  cust_id, yyyymm || '01' yyyymmdd,sum(GROSS_INCM)  AMT-- TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, BAL_AMT, GROSS_INCM

        WHERE  TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) IN ('2E3000', '2E3200', '2E3300', '2E3400') AND YYYYMM>='202312' and YYYYMM<='202505'
        group by cust_id,yyyymm
        ) 
GROUP BY cust_id,yyyymmdd;

             case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'

            TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, sum(BAL_AMT) as AMT 
    FROM DSDEP.DEP_NT_ACCT@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
    group by cust_id,DATA_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACT_CD,
             case 
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2311','2321','2322','2331','2332','2333','2335','2336') then '台幣存款'
              when trim(ACT_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end   
;

as 
    SELECT  cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,'存款' as TYP,'台幣' AS TYP_DTL,
            case 
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2317','2327') then '外幣存款'
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end as DETAIL,
            TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACC_CD, sum(AVAIL_BAL) as 存款AUM--  '台幣'  AS TYP,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD) PRFT_CNTR_CD, ACT_CD, AVAIL_BAL, GROSS_INCM 
    FROM DSDEP.DEP_FN_ACCT@anadbp01_dwdbp01
    group by cust_Id,LST_MTN_DT,TRIM(PRFT_CNTR_CD), ACC_CD,
          case 
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2317','2327') then '外幣存款'
              when trim(ACC_CD) IN ('2545') then '結構型存款'
             end;

create table AUM
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

properties.sql:
create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
as 
select 
    idno cust_id,to_char(exedate,'yyyymmdd') yyyymmdd,PCCCODE,idno,
    case 
       when trustprd in ('其他-國外有價證券','其他-國外股票','股票') then '海外股票'
       when trustprd ='集合' then '集合管理帳戶'
       when trustprd ='海外債券' then '海外債券(信託)'
       when trustprd ='結構型商品' then '境外結構型商品'
    else trustprd end as trustprd,
    sum(CurrentTWDValue) CurrentTWDValue    
from DSFND.PB_FUND_MONTH@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group by  idno,to_char(exedate,'yyyymmdd') ,PCCCODE,idno,case 
       when trustprd in ('其他-國外有價證券','其他-國外股票','股票') then '海外股票'
       when trustprd ='集合' then '集合管理帳戶'
       when trustprd ='海外債券' then '海外債券(信託)'
       when trustprd ='結構型商品' then '境外結構型商品'
    else trustprd end;

create table AUM
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,

    amt

select

    '銀行'  COMP,

select

select

select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,

    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,

    yyyymmdd,
    AMT

create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_020
as
select a.yyyymmdd,a.cust_id,a.AMT
from AUM_020_TMP01 a
inner join 
  (
  select   substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,max(yyyymmdd) yyyymmdd
  from AUM_020_TMP01
  group by substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)
  ) b
on a.yyyymmdd=b.yyyymmdd;

properties.sql:
create table AUM_020
as
select a.yyyymmdd,a.cust_id,a.AMT
from AUM_020_TMP01 a
inner join 
  (
  select   substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,max(yyyymmdd) yyyymmdd
  from AUM_020_TMP01
  group by substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)
  ) b
on a.yyyymmdd=b.yyyymmdd;

properties.sql:
create table AUM
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_021
as
select a.yyyymmdd,a.cust_id,a.AMT
from AUM_021_TMP01 a
inner join 
  (
  select   substr(yyyymmdd,1,6) yyyymm,max(yyyymmdd) yyyymmdd
  from AUM_021_TMP01
  group by substr(yyyymmdd,1,6)
  ) b
on a.yyyymmdd=b.yyyymmdd;

    yyyymmdd,

    '證券'  COMP,

properties.sql:
create table AUM_023_024_TMP0
as 
select idno as cust_id,prcs_dt as yyyymmdd,nm,sum(NETQTY/100 *CPRICE * exch_rt) AMT
from 
      (select a.*,
              case when  bond like 'TSSN%' then '複委託結構型商品'
              else '複委託債券' end as NM
      from  DSPBM.PB_BONDPOS_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a ) a
left join 
     ( select A.*
     from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
     inner join 
     ( 
         select substr(prcs_dt,1,6) yyyyymm,max(prcs_dt) prcs_dt 
         from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
         group by substr(prcs_dt,1,6)
     ) b on a.prcs_dt=b.prcs_dt
     )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and a.yyyymm=substr(b.prcs_dt,1,6)
group by idno,prcs_dt,nm
;

create table AUM_026_TMP0
as 
select   idno as cust_id,b.prcs_dt yyyymmdd,sum(NETQTY * CPRICE* exch_rt) as amt 
from  (select *
      from  DSPBM.PB_STOCKPOS_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a ) a
left join 
     ( select A.*
     from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
     inner join 
     ( 
         select substr(prcs_dt,1,6) yyyyymm,max(prcs_dt) prcs_dt 
         from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
         group by substr(prcs_dt,1,6)
     ) b on a.prcs_dt=b.prcs_dt
     )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and a.yyyymm=substr(b.prcs_dt,1,6)
group by idno,b.prcs_dt
;

) a 
group by idno,clrdate,nm;

properties.sql:
create table AUM
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_026_TMP0
as 
select   idno as cust_id,b.prcs_dt yyyymmdd,sum(NETQTY * CPRICE* exch_rt) as amt 
from  (select *
      from  DSPBM.PB_STOCKPOS_SEC_M@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a ) a
left join 
     ( select A.*
     from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 a
     inner join 
     ( 
         select substr(prcs_dt,1,6) yyyyymm,max(prcs_dt) prcs_dt 
         from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
         group by substr(prcs_dt,1,6)
     ) b on a.prcs_dt=b.prcs_dt
     )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and a.yyyymm=substr(b.prcs_dt,1,6)
group by idno,b.prcs_dt

properties.sql:
create table AUM_026_TMP1
as 
select  idno as cust_id,yyyymmdd,sum(NETQTY * CPRICE* exch_rt) as amt 
  from 
 (
  select idno, CLRDATE  YYYYMMDD,NETQTY ,CPRICE,currency --
  from DSPBM.PB_STOCKPOS_SEC@anadbp01_dwdbp01
  ) a
  left join 
  (
  select * from dsdep.fn_exch_rt@anadbp01_dwdbp01 --where prcs_dt='20240401'
  )b  on a.currency=b.curr_cd and yyyymmdd=prcs_dt
  group by idno,yyyymmdd;

properties.sql:
create table AUM
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_TMP01
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

create table AUM_027
as 
select cust_id,yyyymmdd,sum(amt) amt
from 
(
select YTRMRB025 as cust_id,yyyymmdd,YTRMRB110 * YTRMRB150  as amt
from dspbm.pb_ytrmrbp_sec_m@anadbp01_dwdbp01
union 
select YTRMRB025 as cust_id,yyyymmdd,YTRMRB110 * YTRMRB150  as amt
from dspbm.pb_ytrmrbp_sec@anadbp01_dwdbp01
) a
group by cust_id,yyyymmdd;

create table AUM
as
select    
    TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    DETAIL as PROD,
    TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    LST_MTN_DT AS YYYYMMDD,
    存款AUM AMT
from AUM_005_007_008_009  --存款AUM 總量、台幣存款AUM總量、結構型
where DETAIL is not null
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012  --【銀行】保險_原始投資金額
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '保險'  PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    CUST_ID,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
FROM aum_012
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    trustprd PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    CurrentTWDValue as AMT
from AUM_013_015_015_016_017_018
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '海外債券(自營)' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    YYYYMMDD,
    amt 
from  AUM_019 --19.銀行_外國債券(自營平台)_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_020 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '規劃型信託' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_021 --銀行_規劃型信託_AUM總量--【銀行】股票及金錢信託_市值
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '銀行'  COMP,
    '信託保管' PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id ,
    yyyymmdd,
    amt 
from  AUM_022  --銀行_信託保管_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    nm  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_023_024--證券_複委託債券_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '基金'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_025  ----25.證券_基金_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '外國股票'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_026  --26.證券_外國股票_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_027   --27.證券_台股_AUM總量
union 
select 
    '投資'  TYP,
    '證券'  COMP,
    '台股'  as PROD,
    NULL AS TYP_SUB_DTL,
    cust_id,
    yyyymmdd,
    AMT
from AUM_028   ----28.股票設質
;

select to_char(to_date(applydate,'yyyy/mm/dd'),'YYYYMMDD') YYYYMMDD ,lendinguserid as cust_id,sum(Qty * Product_Price) amt
from DSCSD.PBCMS_REPORTA03@anadbp01_dwdbp01
group by to_char(to_date(applydate,'yyyy/mm/dd'),'YYYYMMDD') ,lendinguserid;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_048  --私人銀行事業處業績檔(保管)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '黃金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_049 --銀行 黃金 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FLG,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_051_054 --【證券】複委託-債券手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '基金' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_052 --【證券】複委託-基金手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '證券'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國股票' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_053 --【證券】複委託-外國股票手收 總量
union 
select 
      '利收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '存款' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_066 --存款利收總量
union 
select

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_041
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境外' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_042  --【銀行】境外結構型商品手收 總量*/
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_043   --銀行 FX(WBS) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'FX' as SUB_TYPE, 
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_044  --銀行 FX(TMU) 手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '開狀' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_045  --【銀行】開狀手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_046  --規劃型信託(股票信託、金錢信託)
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '規劃型信託' as SUB_TYPE,
      '',
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_047  --規劃型信託(員工持股信託)
union

group by cust_id ,lst_mtn_dt;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險

create table INCOME_031
as 
select baopcccode as PCCODE,
       idno as cust_id ,
       to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd'),'yyyymmdd') as yyyymmdd, 
       sum(BRHREBATEAMT+(WKR028/100)) amt--baopcccode,sum(BRHREBATEAMT+(WKR028/100)) --feedate,sum(BRHREBATEAMT+(WKR028/100))
from DSFND.PB_FUND_SPREAD_DAILY@anadbp01_dwdbp01
where FHID='CB' --and substr(feedate,1,6)='011403'--01121227    
and baopcccode like '%2E%'    --私銀處
group by baopcccode,idno,feedate;

create table INCOME_033_034_035_036
as 
select  to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' ) as yyyymmdd --substr(FEEDATE,1,6)  -- FHID,IDNO as cust_id,      
        ,idno as cust_id       
        ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
        end as   FH_TYP 
        ,baopcccode PCCODE
        ,sum(BrhRebateAmt) as AMT
from DSFND.PB_FUND_SPREAD_DAILY@anadbp01_dwdbp01 
where  (baopcccode like '2E%' or saopcccode like '2E%') and feedate>='011212'  --and feedate='011403' 
group by  
      to_char(to_date(feedate+19110000,'yyyymmdd') ,'yyyymmdd' )   --substr(FEEDATE,1,6),
      ,idno
      ,case 
              when FHID not in ('PS','CB','YB','SN') then '基金' 
              when TRIM(FHID) ='YB' then 'ETF'
              when FHID ='PS' then '海外股票'
              when FHID like 'TA%' or FHID  like 'TB%' or FHID  like 'TD%' or FHID  like 'TE%'  then '集合管理帳戶'
       end
       ,baopcccode;

Create table INCOME_TMP01
as 
select      
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE,
      dept_easy_nm as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_028  --各區當日手收數字(保險)
union
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT 
from INCOME_029 --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '保險' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      '' as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_030  --各區每月手收數字(保險
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '海外債券_信託' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      PCCODE as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_031  --【銀行】海外債券手收 總量
union 
select  
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '外國債券_自營' AS   SUB_TYPE, 
      pccode as  NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd ,
      AMT          
from INCOME_032  --【銀行】外國債券(自營平台)手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      FH_TYP as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE as NM,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_033_034_035_036
where FH_TYP is not null
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_037  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      'DCI' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_038  --【銀行】DCI 手收 總量 --TMU損益
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_039   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
      '結構型_境內' as SUB_TYPE,
      PCCODE,
      cust_id,
      yyyymmdd,
      AMT
from INCOME_040   --境內結構型商品手收 
union 
select 
      '手收'  as  TYP,
      '銀行'  as  PROD_TYPE,
